title: Hontiveros seeks release of Percy Lapid's son detained in US

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Friday appealed to US Immigration authorities for the immediate release of Mark Mabasa, son of slain broadcast journalist Percival “Percy Lapid” Mabasa, who has been detained in California since Sept. 21. Mabasa is being held at the Adelanto Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) Processing Center, according to his uncle, journalist Roy Mabasa. US ICE records did not indicate the reason for his detention. Hontiveros said the government should assist Mabasa and his family, who sought asylum in the United States following death threats they received after Lapid was killed in 2022. “It is unacceptable […]...
